title: Make This Go On Forever
original_lyrics:
[chorus]
Please don't let this turn in to something it's not
I can only give you everything i've got
I can't be as sorry as you think i should

[bridge]
All that i keep thing throughout this whole flight
Is it could take my whole damn life to make this right
The splintered mast i'm holding on won't save me long

[bridge]
The last Girl and the last reason to make this as long as i could
The first kiss and the first time that i felt connected to anything
The weight of the water the way you taught me to look past everything i have ever learned
The final word in the final sentence ever uttered to me was love
we have go through so much worse than this before
Whats so different this time that you can't ignore
You say it is much more than just my last mistake
And we should spend some time apart for both our sakes
The last Girl and the last reason to make this as long as i could
The first kiss and the first time that i felt connected to anything
The weight of the water the way you taught me to look past everything i have ever learned
The final word in the final sentence ever uttered to me was love
The last Girl and the last reason to make this as long as i could
The first kiss and the first time that i felt connected to anything
The weight of the water the way you taught me to look past everything i have ever learned
The final word in the final sentence ever uttered to me was love
And i don't know where to look
My words just break and melt
Please just save me from this darkness
Please just save me from this darkness
And i don't know where to look
My words just break and melt
Please just save me from this darkness
Please just save me from this darkness
